name: Embodiment Principle
fact: People learn better from onscreen multimedia lessons when a gesturing pedagogical agent is added to the screen.
boundary: The effect is observed for transfer and retention, but adding a static agent does not improve performance.

provenance.title: Animated pedagogical agents as aids in multimedia learning: Effects on eye-fixations during learning and learning outcomes.
provenance.quote_or_locus: Results support the embodiment principle that people learn better from onscreen multimedia lessons when a gesturing PA is added to the screen
